About

Pillar is a static site generator with a visual editor, built on Liqx — a JSX-flavoured template language for PHP that keeps the section/schema model but swaps {{ }} for real HTML and real expressions.

The whole product is three commands:

  • pillar dev — a dashboard and a live preview, on your machine
  • pillar build — the site, as plain HTML files
  • pillar deploy — those files, on whichever host you use

There is no database. A site is a directory: templates and content are files, saving is file_put_contents, and git is the store — draft is the working tree, publish is a commit, history is git log.
